title: Serenity Villa
description: A sweeping open-plan living space featuring custom Italian marble flooring, bespoke walnut joinery, and curated art collection from local artists.

title: The Ivory Suite
description: A master bedroom retreat draped in warm ivory and beige tones, with a custom fluted headboard, built-in wardrobe, and abundant natural light.

title: Ivory Kitchen
description: A chef's dream kitchen with Calacatta marble counters, handleless German cabinetry, and a sprawling kitchen island perfect for entertaining.

title: Corporate Axis
description: A forward-thinking corporate office blending biophilic design with precision-engineered workstations and collaborative zones.

title: Sage Bathroom
description: A spa-inspired sanctuary with fluted stone walls, a rainfall shower, and a freestanding soaking tub framed by arched niches.

title: The Grand Lobby
description: A five-star hotel lobby with a 9-metre ceiling chandelier installation, travertine reception desk, and hand-knotted silk carpets.

title: Monsoon Living
description: Inspired by Kerala's lush landscape, this living room features rattan furniture, clay-toned walls, and floor-to-ceiling plantation shutters.

title: Crystal Penthouse
description: An Art Deco-inspired penthouse with custom crystal chandeliers, chevron oak parquet, and a panoramic bar overlooking the Arabian Sea.

title: Terracotta Dining
description: A heritage-infused dining room featuring jaali screens, hand-painted terracotta tiles, and a rustic yet refined dining table for 12.

title: The Loft
description: A creative studio loft with exposed concrete ceilings, industrial steel shelving, and flexible workspaces designed for a design agency.

title: Azure Bedroom
description: A coastal bedroom suite with deep blue linen walls, driftwood accents, and a private terrace overlooking the Arabian Sea.

title: Obsidian Kitchen
description: A dramatic all-black kitchen with obsidian cabinetry, brushed brass hardware, and a backlit onyx splashback that glows at night.
